blurb: Guests can rent various boats for half or full day use, join private charters with a captain, participate in scheduled tow sessions towed behind a wake boat, or attend multi-day surf camps for kids and teens. Boats include pontoons and deck boats suitable for watersports. Surf camps teach wake surfing and boating safety with certified instructors.
